title: The Poison in the Square
summary: Nalan Yanran watches the finals with her grandfather Nalan Jie, who urges her to apologise to Xiao Yan after the Three-Year Agreement; she refuses. Xiao Yan refines his herbs first with his Heavenly Flame and attempts a Two Lines Green Spirit Pill by switching flames. Black dust from Yan Li's poison-soaked body drifts over the square and ruins other contestants' pills. Fa Ma will not stop the contest, because no rule forbids it. Xiao Yan's pill fails, while Yan Li forms a pill that gives off Colored Pill Fragrance, a strong Fourth-Tier Pill. Shaken, Xiao Yan remembers his father's words and Yao Lao's lessons, lets go of his guilt, and his Soul Power surges.
